title: Great set !
text: Great set !. These are amazing. The quantity is 60 pieces..30 are containers..30 are the lids. The tops are hard to get on but only until you get used to them.they fit so perfectly to be air tight..which is why its harder to close them. The sizes are so nice. You get a nice variety ofnsizes that stack well and they dont slip off each other because of the rubber material on the tops. You even get little round containers perfect for condiments! The largest is tall enough to hold 4-5 packages of spahgetti noodles.
